blocks.text: 1928 mein Paul Dirac ne peshgoi ki ke har bunyadi zarre ka ek anti-particle (ulta zarra) hota hai. Anti-particle ka rest mass (thehri halat ka mass) apne zarre jitna hota hai magar charge ulta. Maslan positron electron ka anti-particle hai, alamat e⁺. Positron ka rest mass electron jitna hai magar us par utni hi miqdar ka positive charge hai. Positron sab se pehla daryaft hone wala anti-particle tha: Anderson ne ise 1932 mein cloud chamber ke tajurbe mein dekha. Yeh kisi anti-particle ki pehli tajurbati daryaft thi; is ke baad bohat se anti-particles mile. Aam taur par anti-particle ko harf ke oopar bar (lakeer) laga kar likhte hain, maslan anti-proton p̄ aur antineutrino ν̄.
Daryaft hone wale bohat se zarron mein se quarks aur leptons ko fundamental (bunyadi) zarre, yani elementary particles, mana gaya hai. In elementary zarron ke bhi anti-particles hain.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: 1. Particle accelerator ek bari machine hai jo electrons, protons ya ions jaise charged zarron ko bohat zyada energy aur roshni ki speed ke qareeb speeds tak tez karti hai. 2. Linear accelerators, cyclotrons aur betatrons aham particle accelerators hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Is daryaft par Dirac aur Anderson ko Physics ka Nobel Prize mila: Dirac ko 1933 mein aur Anderson ko 1936 mein. 1955 mein Segre aur Chamberlain ne particle accelerator se antiproton daryaft kiya aur 1959 mein anhein is par Physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: (i) Cosmic rays khala (outer space) se aane wale bohat zyada energy ke zarre hain; in ka source pakka maloom nahi, shayad Suraj ya doosre sitare. Yeh zyada tar protons, neutrons aur bhaari nuclei hain jo Zameen par musalsal barste hain. Fiza (atmosphere) ki gason ke atoms se takra kar yeh secondary zarron ki barish (showers) banate hain jo hum par har waqt barasti hai. (ii) Jab uranium-235 jaise unstable radioactive element ke nuclei nuclear reactor mein fission (toot) karte hain to neutrons, neutrinos, α-particles, photons, electrons aur positrons jaise mukhtalif zarre nikalte hain. (iii) Jab electrons aur protons jaise charged zarron ko accelerator se tez kar ke hydrogen jaise target par mara jaye, to yeh aapas mein aamne saamne bhi takra sakte hain; in takkaron ke malbe mein pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons tak milte hain.

Pair production tab hota hai jab gamma ray photon (bohat zyada energy wala photon) kisi atomic nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai: photon ghayab ho jata hai aur ek electron-positron jora (pair) ban jata hai (Fig. 12.1). Linear momentum barqarar (conserve) rakhne ke liye teesre zarre, jaise nucleus, ka hona zaroori hai. Mass-energy equivalence (E = mc²) ke mutabiq photon ki kam az kam energy dono naye zarron ki rest mass energies ke jor ke barabar honi chahiye. Electron-positron jore ki rest mass energy 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV hai, aur tajurbe ne yeh sabit kiya hai. 1.02 MeV se kam energy wala gamma photon jora nahi bana sakta; 1.02 MeV se zyada energy wala photon jora banata hai aur bachi hui energy dono zarron ki kinetic energy ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Pair production khaali jagah (vacuum ya space) mein nahi ho sakta. Yeh sirf tab hota hai jab koi bahar ka jism, jaise atomic nucleus, maujood ho jo takkar mein thora peeche hat (recoil) kar energy aur momentum dono ko ek saath barqarar rakhe.
Pair production mein charge, momentum aur energy, teenon ki conservation (baqa) qaim rehti hai: photon par charge zero tha, aur e⁻ aur e⁺ ke charges mil kar bhi zero hain.

blocks.alt: Lehrdar (wavy) photon, jis par hν likha hai, seedhe teer ke saath nucleus tak aata hai; nucleus nucleons ka guchha (cluster) dikhaya gaya hai. Nucleus se positron (+e, kinetic energy K₊) oopar aur electron (-e, kinetic energy K₋) neeche nikalta hai; dono photon ki raah ko aage barhati dashed lakeer se θ zaviya (angle) banate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: Zyada energy wala photon nucleus se taamul kar ke electron aur positron ke joray mein badal jata hai (kitab ki Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Photon baen se aata hai. Positron oopar wale raste par hara gola aur electron neeche wale raste par grey gola hai; siron ke teeron par K₊ aur K₋ likha hai, aur dono barabar zaviye θ dashed lakeer se naape gaye hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se aane wali lehar gamma photon hai jis ki energy hν hai. Yeh nucleus ke qareeb ghayab ho kar do zarre banata hai: oopar hara positron (+e) aur neeche electron (−e). K₊ aur K₋ in dono ki kinetic energies hain, aur dono zarre photon ki seedhi raah (dashed lakeer) se barabar zawiye θ par nikalte hain. Nucleus is liye zaroori hai ke woh thora peeche hat kar (recoil) momentum barqarar rakhta hai. Photon ki energy kam az kam 1.02 MeV honi chahiye; is se zyada energy K₊ aur K₋ ban jati hai.
Annihilation (fana hona) pair production ka ulat amal hai. Jab electron aur positron milte hain to dono khatam ho kar do gamma ray photons ban jate hain (Fig. 12.2). Reaction:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 12.4' ka hawala deti hai, magar electron aur positron ka annihilation Figure 12.2 mein hai; Fig. 12.4 to teen radioactive radiations wali figure hai.

Har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai, jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy E = m₀c² ke barabar hai. Annihilation mein energy aur momentum barqarar rehte hain (isi liye do photons ulti simton mein jate hain). Electron-positron ke ilawa doosre zarre aur un ke anti-particles bhi fana ho sakte hain, maslan proton aur antiproton, lepton aur antilepton, quark aur antiquark.

blocks.alt: Ek ufuqi (horizontal) lakeer par baen taraf electron e⁻ aur daen taraf positron e⁺ hai. Beech mein ek amoodi (vertical) lehrdar lakeer use kaatti hai, aur teer dikhate hain ke ek gamma ray oopar aur doosri neeche jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.2: Electron aur positron ka milaap (fusion) (kitab ki Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Electron (e⁻) baen se aur positron (e⁺) daen se ek doosre ki taraf aate hain aur beech mein mil kar fana (annihilate) ho jate hain. Un ki jagah do gamma photons bante hain jo ulti simton mein, ek oopar aur ek neeche, jate hain taa ke momentum barqarar rahe. Har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai, jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy ke barabar hai.

CERN mein zarron ki bohat zyada energy wali takkaron se pata chala hai ke takrane wale zarron ka kuch mass Einstein ki equation (E = mc²) ke mutabiq electromagnetic radiation ban jata hai, aur bacha hua mass naye sub-atomic zarron ki shakal mein zahir hota hai (kitab ki Figure 12.3 ek proton-proton takkar ki tasveer hai jis mein 18 naye zarre bane).

blocks.prompt: Kya 20 keV energy ke photons se pair production ho sakti hai (short question 12.8)? Electron-positron jora ek photon mein decay kyun nahi ho sakta (short question 12.13)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Electron aur positron banane ke liye kam az kam 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV chahiye, aur 20 keV is se kahin kam hai. Ek photon momentum nahi le ja sakta: jis frame mein jora aaram mein ho us ka kul momentum sifar hai, magar ek photon ka hamesha momentum E/c hota hai, to momentum aur energy dono baqi nahi reh sakte; ulti simton mein chalte do photons sifar kul momentum ke saath energy baant sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Matter aur antimatter mein kya farq hai (comprehensive question 12.3)? Pair annihilation misal se samjhaiye aur tib mein is ka istemal bataiye (comprehensive question 12.4).
blocks.explanation: Antiparticle ka mass us ke zarre jitna magar charge (aur magnetic khusoosiyat) ulat hota hai: positron electron ka, antiproton proton ka antiparticle hai; antimatter antiparticles se bana hai. Jab zarra apne antiparticle se milta hai to dono fana ho jate hain aur un ka mass energy ban jata hai; electron aur positron ulti simton mein chalte 0.51 MeV ke do gamma photons dete hain. Positron emission tomography (PET) mein mareez ko positron kharij karne wala tracer diya jata hai; har positron jism ke electron se fana hota hai, aur mareez ke gird detectors ulte gamma photons ke jore pakar kar dikhate hain ke tracer kahan jama hua.

items: Dirac (1928): har zarre ka anti-particle, wahi rest mass, ulta charge; positron e⁺ Anderson ne 1932 mein dekha; antiproton Segre aur Chamberlain ne 1955 mein. Accelerators, cosmic rays aur fission bohat se zarre banate hain.

Pair production: nucleus ke qareeb kam az kam 1.02 MeV ka gamma photon → e⁻ + e⁺. Annihilation: e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ, har photon 0.51 MeV; charge, momentum, energy barqarar. CERN: kuch mass radiation, baqi naye zarre.
